shots.steps: register a client ('Cvičím pro sebe') with a new email; read the verification email in the harness MailHog (UI port: docker compose port mailhog-test 8025); open its link on the dev server, replacing the host with the dev server's if it differs and keeping ?token=; open it only once (the token is single-use)
